facts.text: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.
facts.why: No crab scene in the transcript or plot. The film has Schmidt and Jenko at MC State, then on spring break.
facts.fix: Serve the crab when Schmidt and Jenko hit the beach for spring break.

vibe.verdict: The college dining hall suits the film, but it is plain and misses the Ghost, WHY-PHY and the end credits sequels.
